name: Standard Reserve
description: A sovereign onchain central bank protocol that tracks one number, defends its own currency, and answers to no one. Features complex scroll-driven animations and a highly polished UI.
features: Implemented high-performance, scroll-driven animations using GSAP and ScrollTrigger for a cinematic experience.
Built a modular, component-based React architecture for maintainability and scalability.
Designed and engineered complex UI interactions including a custom magnetic cursor and scroll-linked timeline scrubbing.
